name: davinci-ai-smart-commiter
description: Generate detailed Conventional Commits messages (subject + bullet body) from your staged git diff using Claude, OpenAI, Kimi, DeepSeek, or Gemini.

aiCommitAssistant.provider.markdownDescription: Choose the AI provider used to generate commit messages. API keys are stored in VS Code Secret Storage via the matching `Set ... API Key` command.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Conventional Commits subject plus a bulleted body that lists every meaningful change (new files, components, queries, routes, tests, config...).
A single Conventional Commits subject line.
aiCommitAssistant.commitStyle.markdownDescription: How much detail the generated commit message contains.

aiCommitAssistant.customInstructions.markdownDescription: Extra project-specific rules for the AI, e.g. `Use Jira key from branch`, `Write in Swahili`, `Allowed scopes: api, web, accounting`. These override the built-in rules.

aiCommitAssistant.autoStage.markdownDescription: Run `git add -A` before generating the commit message.

aiCommitAssistant.temperature.markdownDescription: Controls creativity. Lower values make commit messages more consistent. Ignored by models that do not accept a custom temperature (Claude Opus 4.7+, Claude 5 family, OpenAI GPT-5/o-series, Kimi K2.5+).

aiCommitAssistant.maxTokens.markdownDescription: Maximum output tokens for the generated commit message. In `detailed` style at least 1024 is used; thinking/reasoning models automatically get at least 4096.

aiCommitAssistant.diff.maxChars.markdownDescription: Maximum characters of the staged diff sent to the model. When the diff is larger, every file gets a fair share (small files stay whole, big files are trimmed) so no file is ignored. Lock files, minified files, source maps and snapshots are never sent.

aiCommitAssistant.context.maxFiles.markdownDescription: Maximum modified files whose full staged content is sent as surrounding context (most-changed first). Set to `0` to disable.

aiCommitAssistant.context.maxChars.markdownDescription: Maximum total characters of surrounding file context to send to the model.

aiCommitAssistant.context.maxCharsPerFil.markdownDescription: Maximum characters to include from each staged source/config file.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Latest Haiku: fast and very low cost. Default.
Latest Sonnet: balanced speed and intelligence.
Latest Opus: highest capability.
Previous Sonnet.
Previous Opus.
Previous Haiku.
Legacy fast model.
aiCommitAssistant.anthropic.model.markdownDescription: Anthropic model used when provider is `anthropic`. Use `Davinci AI Smart Commiter: Select Default Model` to change it without typing.

aiCommitAssistant.anthropic.effort.markdownDescription: Effort level for Claude models that support it (Claude 5 family, Opus 4.5+). `low` is fast and cheap and is plenty for commit messages. Older models ignore it.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Latest fast, low-cost reasoning model. Default.
Fast, affordable, non-reasoning.
Stronger coding model, lower cost than flagship.
Lowest latency and cost.
Higher capability.
Flagship coding and professional work model.
aiCommitAssistant.openai.model.markdownDescription: OpenAI model used when provider is `openai`. Use `Davinci AI Smart Commiter: Select Default Model` to change it without typing.

aiCommitAssistant.openai.reasoningEffort.markdownDescription: Reasoning effort for OpenAI reasoning models (GPT-6, GPT-5, o-series). `medium` is the default. Higher levels are slower; raise `requestTimeoutSeconds` if you use `high` or above. Ignored by non-reasoning models such as GPT-4o mini.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Latest Kimi model; thinking is always on, depth set by `kimi.reasoningEffort`. Default.
Faster output variant of K3.1 Pro.
Previous Kimi coding and agent model (thinking disabled by the extension).
Previous Kimi K2 multimodal model (thinking disabled by the extension).
Short text generation model.
Longer text generation model.
Very long context text generation model.
aiCommitAssistant.kimi.model.markdownDescription: Kimi/Moonshot model used when provider is `kimi`. K3.1 Pro always thinks; its depth is set by `aiCommitAssistant.kimi.reasoningEffort`. For K2.6/K2.5 the extension disables thinking.

aiCommitAssistant.kimi.reasoningEffort.markdownDescription: Reasoning effort for Kimi K3+ models, which always think. `low` is fastest; the API default would be `max`.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Latest Flash model, version DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017. Default.
Stronger reasoning/coding model (DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813).
Retired name; requests are now served by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017.
aiCommitAssistant.deepseek.model.markdownDescription: DeepSeek model used when provider is `deepseek`. Thinking is controlled by `aiCommitAssistant.deepseek.reasoningEffort`.

aiCommitAssistant.deepseek.reasoningEffo.markdownDescription: Thinking for DeepSeek models. `none` turns thinking off (fastest and cheapest, the default); other values enable thinking with that effort.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Best price-performance default.
Fastest and most budget-friendly 2.5 model.
More advanced reasoning and coding.
aiCommitAssistant.gemini.model.markdownDescription: Google Gemini model used when provider is `gemini`. Use `Davinci AI Smart Commiter: Select Default Model` to change it without typing.

aiCommitAssistant.gemini.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Google Gemini OpenAI-compatible API base URL.

aiCommitAssistant.requestTimeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Abort the AI request if it takes longer than this. Rate-limit and server errors are retried automatically.

aiCommitAssistant.context.recentCommits.markdownDescription: Number of recent commit subjects sent so the AI reuses your repository's scope names and conventions. Set to `0` to disable.
